figures.alt: White horizontal shiplap wall with even board gaps, level, and neatly staged trim materials
figures.caption: The visual result depends on the first layout line. Confirm the wall is reasonably flat, choose the reveal, and plan the board sequence before fastening the visible rows.
figures.before: When You Need a Permit in Jacksonville

figures.alt: Clean interior trim miters and an even jamb reveal beside a finished wall
figures.caption: An accent wall has to resolve cleanly at trim, corners, and outlets. Small spacing decisions become very visible when the boards reach a door casing or painted edge.

figures.alt: Straight drywall corner bead and thin finish compound prepared on an interior wall
figures.caption: Finish carpentry lasts better over a stable surface. Repair damaged drywall or a proud corner first instead of using shiplap to disguise movement or an uneven wall plane.
